personal.bio1: Hi, I'm Ömer — a Software Engineering graduate from Istanbul Aydın University, where I earned my degree studying entirely in English. Throughout my degree I built real products: web applications, mobile apps, AI-assisted tools, and embedded systems — getting hands-on with the full development process from day one, not just in theory.
personal.bio2: My experience spans frontend development, backend services, database design, and API integration. During my internship at Cabitas I worked directly on production systems — contributing to database architecture, maintaining application workflows, and collaborating in a real engineering team. I bring both a builder's instinct and an engineer's eye for quality to everything I ship.
personal.bio3: Beyond core development, I also take on digital and visual work — landing pages, branding, and catalogs. Whether a client needs a web platform, a mobile product, or a complete online presence, I handle the project end-to-end: one person, full ownership, no handoffs.

work.description: Building and delivering web applications, mobile apps, and design projects for clients across various industries. Managing projects end-to-end — from requirements and architecture through development, testing, and deployment.

Worked on production software systems and database management. Contributed to designing, maintaining, and updating database structures and application workflows. Collaborated with the team on real-world development tasks and gained hands-on experience with live systems.

education.description: Studied entirely in English. Built multiple practical projects throughout the degree — web applications, mobile apps, an AI-assisted task management tool, IoT systems, and a firefighting drone as the graduation project. Strong emphasis on hands-on engineering and real delivered work over pure theory.

1.content: Ömer delivered our SaaS dashboard ahead of schedule and exceeded every expectation. His code quality is exceptional, and his communication throughout the project was outstanding. We've already rehired him for a second project.

2.content: We needed a complex e-commerce mobile app built fast. Ömer delivered a polished, production-ready app in 8 weeks. The attention to UX detail and the smooth animations made a real difference in our user reviews.

3.content: Working with Ömer on our analytics platform was a pleasure from start to finish. He understood the technical requirements immediately, asked the right questions, and delivered clean, maintainable code we were proud to ship.

4.content: The restaurant management system Ömer built has transformed how we run our kitchens. Real-time orders, zero paper waste, and the staff picked it up in minutes. Best tech investment we've made.

5.content: Ömer joined mid-project and quickly got up to speed. His ability to understand complex requirements and translate them into clean React components is rare. He's now our go-to developer for frontend work.
